narrative.overview: Every directory is a rail line. Claude Code loads configuration stop by stop, and ccdesk draws that order as a route strip, then lists everything that applies as a printed timetable underneath, each row carrying the route bullet of its scope. Light is Swiss timetable print; dark is a departure board at night. Dense, flat, one 32px row grid, grotesk for the interface and tabular mono for anything compared across rows.
keyCharacteristics: Route bullets (letter in a flat colour circle) on every row, stop and layer.
One 32px row grid shared by timetables and palette results.
Grotesk for interface, tabular monospace for keys, paths, values and counts.
Flat surfaces; 2px ink rules open sections, hairlines divide rows.
Two themes from one token set: timetable paper and departure board.

rules.name: The Line Colour Rule
rules.body: A scope-line colour means 'this came from that scope' and nothing else; it appears only in bullets, the route strip and the brand mark.

rules.name: The Letter Rule
rules.body: A scope colour is never shown without its letter (M, U, P, L, A, X).

rules.name: The State Words Rule
rules.body: State inks colour a word that already states the state; never a bare swatch.

rules.name: The Character Grid Rule
rules.body: Paths, keys, values, counts and times are mono with tabular figures so they align across rows.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, column heads and group labels are sentence case at natural tracking.

rules.name: The One Row Rule
rules.body: Every list row is 32px; new lists join the grid.

rules.name: The Inspector Repeats Rule
rules.body: A column may be dropped on smaller screens only if the inspector shows the same fact.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are for the palette, toast and drawer; everything in the layout is flat and ruled.

rules.name: The Shape Not Colour Rule
rules.body: Non-scope categories such as memory types are told apart by ink shape.

dos: Do put a route bullet at the start of every row, stop and layer that comes from a scope; hollow means present but not in force.
Do keep every list row at 32px and set comparable values in tabular mono.
Do open sections with the 2px ink rule and separate rows with hairlines.
Do tell non-scope categories apart by ink shape.
Do show the source file path, in mono and copyable, for anything the inspector shows.
Do preview every write as a diff before Save appears.
Do keep motion at 160-220ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use a scope-line colour for anything other than its scope, or without its letter.
Don't use colour to separate memory types or other non-scope categories.
Don't add shadows to anything that lives in the layout.
Don't put radius on timetable rows or sections, or turn rows into cards.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels or small caption lines above headings.
Don't add icons that are text glyphs or emoji; use the drawn 16px icon set.
